controls.label: Historical model
controls.description: Historical Giotto/Vega shape model by Stooke, with pointing by Abergel. Absolute uncertainty is about 0.5–1 km; depressions may be exaggerated. Neutral gray is a model material. The source long axis and original origin are preserved. Orientation in space is illustrative and held fixed; no spin pole, tumble or current attitude reconstruction is claimed.
